newsitem.title: FRANCE: French shares turn up in line with other markets.
newsitem.headline: French shares turn up in line with other markets.

text.p: French shares turned higher on Wednesday after an easier opening, in line with other markets, dealers said.
The swing back was mainly due to the futures market where the August contract posted a 15 point gain to above 3,000 after an early loss.

"I'm rather surprised by the rise because I'm pessimistic about the market," said a broker. "The dollar/mark is worrying and any sign of an interest rate move will create a chain reaction on the markets," he added.
* CAC-40 index up 12.01, or 0.4 percent, at 2,996.11 at 0850 GMT.
* CAC-40 Aug futures 3,003 vs 2,989 at Tuesdays close.
